EOF

# Generate gnutls.h from gnutls.h.in
cd /workspace/src-vul/gnutls/lib/includes/gnutls
# Simple sed to replace @VERSION@ etc
sed 's/@VERSION@/3.7.9/g; s/@MAJOR_VERSION@/3/g; s/@MINOR_VERSION@/7/g; s/@PATCH_VERSION@/9/g; s/@NUM_VERSION@/030709/g; s/@LIBGNUTLS_API_CURRENT@/30/g; s/@LIBGNUTLS_API_AGE@/0/g; s/@LIBGNUTLS_API_REVISION@/0/g' gnutls.h.in > /tmp/gnutls.h 2>/dev/null || cp gnutls.h.in /tmp/gnutls.h

echo "done"
